Your privacy deserves thoughtful care. Here's how we collect,
        protect, use, and manage your personal information while you
        enjoy the Dunamiss experience.

settings.field_9:
We collect personal information such as name,
              email address, phone number, and payment details
              when you place an order or create an account.
settings.field_10:
Your information is collected only for order
              processing, customer support, and improving our services.
settings.field_11: We do not collect unnecessary personal data.

settings.field_14:
We use secure encryption technologies to protect
              your personal information.
settings.field_15:
All customer data is stored safely and protected
              from unauthorized access.
settings.field_16:
Regular security checks are performed to maintain
              system safety and reliability.
settings.field_18:
We take reasonable measures to keep your personal
                information safe from unauthorized access.

settings.field_21:
Your information is used only for processing orders,
              delivery updates, and customer communication.
settings.field_22:
We never sell, rent, or share your personal data
              with unauthorized third parties.
settings.field_23:
Marketing emails or promotional messages are sent
              only with your consent.

settings.field_26:
You may request access to the personal information
              we store about you.
settings.field_27:
You can request correction or update of inaccurate
              information.
settings.field_28:
You have the right to request deletion of your
              personal data.
settings.field_29:
You may opt out of promotional communications
              at any time.

settings.field_32:
Our website may use cookies to improve browsing
              experience and website performance.
settings.field_33:
Cookies help us understand customer preferences
              and enhance our services.
settings.field_34:
You can disable cookies through your browser settings
              if preferred.

settings.field_37: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
settings.field_38: Changes will be posted on this page with immediate effect.
settings.field_39:
Continued use of our website indicates acceptance
              of the updated policy.

settings.field_41:
Your privacy and data security are important to us.
        For any privacy-related questions, our support team
        is always happy to help.

settings.field_48: Your privacy. Your trust. Our responsibility.
